description: Generates up to eight images in one batch. Items run concurrently, may use same-website image references, and successful outputs become ordinary website assets. An item with `background: "transparent"` stores each output as a native transparent PNG without a separate opaque copy. Read the assets-and-media skill with skills_read first.

idempotencyKey.description: Send the same key when retrying one request so it never generates or bills twice. Omit for a new request.

background.description: `transparent` generates and stores a native transparent PNG for each output, with its own `colors` and `transparentShare`; no separate opaque copy or background-removal pass is created.

category.description: Category stored on each generated asset (what it is, not where it is used).

profile.description: Stable Cactal image profile: `website-image` for general imagery, `logo` for flat logos, marks, and icons.

name: mediaGeneration_generate
title: Generate website images
